ComponentBinding.comment: Binds a custom-element tag string to the npm package that vets and ships it. REFERENCES the sux:renderedByComponent convention: layout triples only ever name tags (e.g. 'mn-sidebar-panel'), and this class is the site-level manifest row (tag -> package -> min version -> persistence class) that says where a tag comes from. It NEVER introduces a parallel tag predicate on layout nodes - sux:renderedByComponent stays the sole tag carrier in layout; unknown tags render the honest fallback.

site:componentTag.source: the custom-element tag EXACTLY as it appears in sux:renderedByComponent literals (e.g. 'mn-sidebar-panel')

site:npmPackage.source: npm package name exporting the vetted @customElement (npm-install-is-vetting in OSS mode)

site:minVersion.source: minimum package version whose manifest declares this tag

site:persistenceClass.source: CURIE of the Emporium vocabulary class the component reads/writes (e.g. 'bm:Bookmark'); a CURIE token, not a resolvable IRI, hence string

site:fallbackTag.source: tag to render when the bound component is not installed; absence means the host's generic unknown-tag fallback

ContentSource.comment: A triple store a planter host reads a site from - the RDF twin of TripleSource and the exact owner+graph hosted boot contract. Local/static sources may omit ownerPrincipal. Liveness is declared, never assumed: push | poll | static. tripleCount 0 is first-class EMPTY status.

site:endpoint.source: base URL of the store: gardend loopback apiUrl, hosted-gateway base (e.g. https://api.canary.sophia-labs.com), or a generic SPARQL endpoint

site:ownerPrincipal.source: exact typed owner principal for a hosted source; omitted only for local/static adapters

site:graphId.source: the graph id passed to the adapter (the {graph} of the three-fact bootstrap)

site:graphIri.source: the named graph actually read, e.g. urn:mnemosyne:local:graph:{id}:ux:config (uxConfigGraphIri)

site:authMode.source: closed host testimony: 'dev' | 'cognito' | 'none' | 'service'. Service means the trusted stateless pool delegated through gateway service-auth; the secret itself is never represented.

site:liveness.source: adapter-declared liveness class: 'push' | 'poll' | 'static' (gardend/gateway MCP reads are 'poll' today; the .nt fossil adapter is 'static')

site:readAt.source: epoch-ms of the last completed read - the TripleSource testimony field (mirrors Attributed<T>.observedAt / turnover readAt); feeds the capture-age chip

site:tripleCount.source: parsed-body triple count of the last read; 0 = first-class EMPTY status (never trust the envelope quadCount)

PackProvenance.comment: NEW (no sux: precursor). A sha-pinned record of which Emporium vocabulary pack version a site was built against. Naming deliberately reuses the wardrobe artifact-reference and testimony conventions (sux:artifactId / sux:contentSha / sux:witness in wardrobe-rdf.ts) and the Emporium golden discipline (the served golden's pinned sha256 IS the contentSha; version bumps mean a new golden + new sha). A site that renders persistence-class-bound components can prove which contract bytes it trusted.

site:packName.source: the Emporium pack name exactly as registered (VOCAB_REGISTRY row / golden 'name' field, e.g. 'shrubbery-site')

site:packVersion.source: the pack's semver as served at /emporium/vocab/{name}/{version}

site:contentSha.source: sha256 of the golden bytes (equals the served ETag; wardrobe contentSha naming)

site:artifactId.source: cell artifact id when the pack bytes are also archived as a graph artifact (wardrobe artifactId naming)

site:witness.source: who attests this pin (wardrobe witness naming - testimony, defeasible, two witnesses may disagree)

site:pinnedAt.source: epoch-ms when the pin was taken

site:vocabUrl.source: where the golden is served, e.g. {endpoint}/emporium/vocab/{name}/{version}

PublicationRoute.comment: A host-owned public or unlisted route to one exact owner+graph tuple. Interpreter identity is copied from the reviewed SiteDefinition by the trusted host; sandbox proposals cannot select it. Published state requires a human approval witness.

site:pathPrefix.source: absolute URL path prefix beginning with slash

site:graphId.source: canonical graph slug paired with ownerPrincipal

site:interpreterPackage.source: reviewed package identity copied from SiteDefinition

site:interpreterVersion.source: exact reviewed interpreter version copied from SiteDefinition

site:approvedBy.source: human user principal required for published state

site:approvedAt.source: time the human approved public publication

Route.comment: Binds a URL path to the existing dim-app machinery that planFor executes. appValue and appRootEntry reference the exact sux nodes emitted by the deployed Nucleus layout serializer; this class neither aliases nor redefines them.

site:path.source: URL path pattern the host serves this route at (e.g. '/', '/emporium')

site:appValue.source: the existing dim-app config-value node (typed sux:ConfigValue) whose sux:literalValue planFor consumes

site:appRootEntry.source: the existing app-root-entry node (typed sux:AppRootEntry) binding the app to its root region set; absent for the default/garden spine

site:surface.source: the site:Surface instance this route lands on - an IRI minted ONLY by the Surface subject rule, under {graph_subject}:projection:site:surface:{localId} in the declared graph projection; examples and implementation must never mint it under http://sophia.ai/ux# (or any ontology namespace)

site:order.source: presentation order among sibling routes (navigation menus)

SiteDefinition.comment: Graph-resident identity for a code-reviewed SiteBundle and the exact interpreter version that gives it meaning. A pool that does not serve this pair must refuse rather than reinterpret the site.

site:interpreterVersion.source: exact package version; no silent upgrade

site:layoutSeedSha256.source: sha256 of the reviewed layout seed bytes

Surface.comment: A navigable presentation of an existing sux layout. workspace, entryRegion, and presentsPanel reference exact nodes emitted by Nucleus. All layout facts remain in the sux graph; Surface adds only site-level naming and entry-point selection.

site:workspace.source: the existing workspace node (typed sux:Workspace) this surface presents

site:entryRegion.source: the existing region node (typed sux:Region) where navigation enters

site:presentsPanel.source: zero or more existing panel nodes (typed sux:Panel) this surface foregrounds; visibility intent only

Theme.comment: A site's default appearance, expressed only as references to the existing dim-theme and dim-skin nodes emitted by Nucleus. Their values and appliesAttribute facts are not restated here.

site:themeDimension.source: the existing theme config-dimension node (typed sux:ConfigDimension)

site:skinDimension.source: the existing skin config-dimension node (typed sux:ConfigDimension)

site:defaultThemeValue.source: the existing default theme config-value node (typed sux:ConfigValue)

site:defaultSkinValue.source: the existing default skin config-value node (typed sux:ConfigValue)

comment: Registered internal-substrate vocabulary for graph-defined Shrubbery sites. A site is an exact owner+graph target whose projection names a code-reviewed bundle and interpreter version. Surface/Route/Theme/ComponentBinding extend existing sux layout facts by reference; PublicationRoute is host-owned routing authority. Instance subjects live in {graph_subject}:projection:site URN space, never inside ontology namespaces.
description: Graph-defined SiteDefinition, exact owner-scoped PublicationRoute, surfaces, local routes, theme, component bindings, redacted content-source testimony, and pack provenance.
name: shrubbery-site

registration.comment: EA-3 registration testimony. The registry name equals this golden's name and Garden pins the sha256 of these exact served bytes.
registration.sha_constant: SHRUBBERY_SITE_GOLDEN_SHA = sha256 of the on-disk golden bytes (recompute with: shasum -a 256 src/emporium/vocabs/shrubbery-site.golden.json), pinned at land time; equals the served ETag
invariants: registry name equals this golden's 'name' field exactly (registry_names_match_golden_names)
NOT a fourth canonical-public pillar - lex-scotus-core precedent (vocabs.rs jurisdiction comment); the pillar question is explicitly Vera's, not this registration's
version bump = new golden + new sha; the served body is the embedded bytes verbatim
